trajectory_summary: The call runs efficiently through the verify sequence with a cooperative customer, but stalls at the credit qualifier when the customer discloses a recent unemployment and a 530 credit score, well below the 670 threshold. This is a legitimate hard DQ per qualifiers.credit_qualifier, but the rep's handling of the disclosure itself was purely transactional — no acknowledgment of the vulnerability, no bridge to any future contact or alternative path.

observed_outcome.reasoning: Customer's credit score of 530 is well below the 670 threshold stated by the rep, triggering the hard DQ per qualifiers.credit_qualifier; no appointment was offered or set.
